 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 05, 2026, 21:11:02 IST SUMMARY India vs Japan Hockey Live Score: India will look to extend their dominance in the Asian Champions Trophy when they take on Japan in the 2026 final on Thursday. Harmanpreet Singh-led India are aiming for a record-extending sixth title after an impressive campaign in which they have remained unbeaten. 
 The hosts booked their place in the summit clash with a commanding 8-1 victory over South Korea in the semi-final. Shilanand Lakra and Dilpreet Singh scored twice each, while Harmanpreet Singh, Sukhjeet Singh, Angad Bir Singh and Vivek Sagar Prasad also found the net. 
 Japan, meanwhile, secured their final berth after defeating Malaysia 5-3 in a penalty shootout following a goalless draw. They finished second in the league stage with 10 points and will be keen to challenge the defending champions. Live Events 
 20:59 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Full Time India are champions! Japan win a last-gasp penalty corner with just 10 seconds remaining, but India's defence stands firm as the drag-flick is blocked. The final whistle follows, confirming a memorable victory for the hosts.
 India defeat Japan to clinch their record sixth Asian Champions Trophy title and complete a hat-trick of consecutive triumphs!
 20:54 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 58'- India 4-1 Japan Less than two minutes remain, and India are on the verge of sealing a memorable victory in Mohali. After falling behind early, the hosts have produced a stunning turnaround in the final quarter, scoring three outstanding goals to take firm control of the contest. 20:50 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 54'- India 4-1 Japan Vivek Sagar Prasad makes it 4-1 with a superb finish on the half-volley. Nilakanta wins a loose ball and sets the attack in motion. Shilanand's initial effort is saved, but the rebound falls perfectly for Vivek, who smashes it past the Japanese goalkeeper. Craig Fulton cannot hide his delight as India take firm control of the title clash. Join conversation

 20:48 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 53'- India 3-1 Japan Jugraj Singh extends India's lead with a thunderous drag-flick from a penalty corner! The opportunity comes after Vivek Sagar Prasad intercepts a pass in midfield and Sukhjeet Singh wins a penalty corner. Jugraj makes no mistake, unleashing a powerful strike that beats the Japanese defence and puts India firmly in control at 3-1. 20:42 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 49': India 2-1 Japan India take the lead for the first time in the final! Dilpreet Singh produces a brilliant finish to put the hosts 2-1 ahead. The move is created by Hardik Singh, who shows great composure under pressure to retain possession inside the circle before setting up Dilpreet. The Indian forward takes a touch and scores with his back to the goalkeeper, sending the Mohali crowd into celebration. 20:31 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 42': India 1-1 Japan India finally find the equaliser! After earning back-to-back penalty corners, Harmanpreet Singh's efforts are saved by Japanese goalkeeper Kisho Kuroda. However, India keep the attack alive, and Shilanand Lakra converts from close range after receiving a brilliant reverse-flick pass from Aditya.
 Japan take a review over a possible dangerous pass, but the TV umpire finds no clear reason to overturn the on-field decision. The goal stands, and India are back on level terms in the final!

Sukhjeet Singh gets a shot away, but the Japanese goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant diving save. Harmanpreet Singh pounces on the rebound and attempts a reverse-flick, only to see his effort crash against the post. 20:19 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 36': India 0-1 Japan Another opportunity for India, but Harmanpreet Singh's low, straight strike is comfortably blocked by the Japanese goalkeeper with his left foot. The home crowd is growing anxious as Japan continue to threaten on quick counter-attacks while protecting their slender lead. 20:17 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 34' - India 0-1 Japan India finally earn their first penalty corner of the final after Sukhjeet Singh's attempt is deliberately blocked by a Japanese defender. However, Harmanpreet Singh fails to convert as his drag-flick is saved by the goalkeeper. Japan quickly launch a counter-attack. 20:12 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 31': India 0-1 Japan The third quarter is underway in Mohali, with India facing a crucial 30 minutes to turn the final around. The hosts are still searching for their first goal and have yet to earn a penalty corner. 20:01 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Half Time India head into the half-time break trailing Japan 0-1 despite showing more urgency in the closing stages of the second quarter.
 Dilpreet Singh came close after getting the ball inside the circle, but his effort took a deflection and resulted in a long corner. Moments later, Hardik Singh made a brilliant run down the right and squared the ball to Dilpreet, only for a Japanese defender to make a crucial interception. Japan's disciplined defence has kept India's attack quiet so far, with the hosts still searching for their first goal of the final.
 19:56 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 25' - India 0-1 Japan India continue to struggle to create clear-cut opportunities in the final, with the hosts yet to earn a single penalty corner. Japan's disciplined defensive setup is keeping the Indian attack at bay. 19:53 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 21': India 0-1 Japan Japan win two penalty corners in quick succession, with the second coming after a successful review for a push by Harmanpreet Singh. However, India's defence stands firm as Amit Rohidas produces a superb block to deny Fujishima's drag-flick. India eventually regain possession. 19:46 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 18': India 0-1 Japan India have come out attacking in the second quarter and are now dominating possession. The hosts are piling pressure on the Japanese defence, with repeated circle entries, but Japan continue to defend in numbers.
 Sukhjeet had an early opportunity but failed to get his shot away, while Watanabe produced a crucial block to deny another Indian attack. Japan remain 1-0 ahead
 19:41 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: End of quarter 1 India finish the first quarter with a flurry of attacking moves but are unable to find the equaliser.
 Jarmanpreet Singh's delivery from the right creates an opportunity for Sukhjeet and Abhishek, but neither can get the finishing touch. Moments later, Hardik Singh tests the Japanese goalkeeper with an effort from the centre of the circle, which is pushed away. Aditya looks to capitalise on the rebound, but a timely tackle from a Japanese defender denies him.
 India also lose an early review after their appeal for a push inside the circle is turned down by the TV umpire. Japan continue to hold a slender 1-0 advantage at the end of the opening quarter, courtesy of Matsumoto's fourth-minute strike.
 19:36 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 12': India 0-1 Japan India are beginning to find their rhythm in possession, with some sharp passing through the midfield. However, they are yet to turn that control into clear-cut chances or trouble the Japanese goalkeeper.
 Abhishek had an opportunity in the 10th minute but his effort went wide, while Angad, positioned near the far post, could not get a stick on the ball for a possible deflection.
 Japan, meanwhile, continue to look organised and disciplined, much like they did in the pool-stage meeting. India will need to find a way through their defence after falling behind to Matsumoto's early strike.
 19:26 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 4' - India 0-1 Japan Japan strike first in the final! Matsumoto picks up the ball on the left, drives into the circle and unleashes a powerful reverse-hit shot past Suraj. The Indian goalkeeper will feel he could have done better with that effort as Japan take an early lead in Mohali. 19:22 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 1': India 0-0 Japan The national anthems are complete, and Japan get the final underway with the opening pushback in Mohali. India take the field in their all-orange kit, while Japan are dressed in blue and attack from right to left. The battle for the Asian Champions Trophy title is officially on! 19:18 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: 200th International Appearance for Hardik Singh A major milestone awaits Indian hockey star Hardik Singh, who is set to make his 200th international appearance today. Widely regarded as one of the finest midfielders in world hockey, Hardik will be felicitated by Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann and other dignitaries ahead of the landmark occasion, adding to the significance of the moment. 19:07 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Nilakanta's farewell match With Nilakanta set to play his final international match, India will be determined to make the occasion special. Having announced his retirement earlier in the tournament, the midfielder will be hoping to bow out on a high, with his teammates eager to send him off with the title. 19:00 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: India's playing squad XI: Suraj Karkera, Jarmanpreet Singh, Hardik SIngh, Dilpreet Singh, Harmanpreet Singh, Nilakanta Sharma, Jugraj Singh, Vivek Sagar Prasad, Sukhjeet Singh, Sanjay, Shilanand Lakra.
 Subs: Abhishek, Krishan Bahadur Pathak, Aditya Lalage, Amit Rohidas, Angad Bir Singh, Amandeep Lakra, Vishnukant Singh.
 18:50 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Malaysia beat Korea Malaysia clinched the bronze medal at the Asian Champions Trophy after defeating South Korea 5-2 on Thursday. Abu Kamal Azrai starred with a brace, scoring twice in the final quarter after Malaysia had recovered from a 1-2 deficit. Fitri Saari, Faizal Saari and Marhan Jalil also found the net to seal the victory. 18:40 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Head-to-head record India have enjoyed a significant advantage over Japan in their previous meetings. According to the available head-to-head statistics, India have won 27 of their 32 encounters, while Japan have registered three victories. Two matches have ended in draws. India also won their most recent meeting in the ongoing tournament, registering a 4-1 victory during the league stage. 18:30 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Japan pose a different challenge Japan finished second in the league standings with 10 points from five matches, registering three victories, one draw and one defeat. They also faced India earlier in the competition, losing 4-1, but managed to trouble the hosts for large periods of that encounter.
 Japan's aggressive high pressing disrupted India's rhythm and forced the hosts into several mistakes. They even managed to draw level at 1-1 before India eventually regained control and secured the victory.
 Japan booked their place in the final after defeating Malaysia in the semi-final. Following a goalless draw in regulation time, they held their nerve in the penalty shootout to win 5-3.
 18:20 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Third consecutive final The result also secured India a place in their third consecutive Asian Champions Trophy final, giving them another opportunity to strengthen their position as the most successful team in the competition. India have previously won the tournament five times, in 2011, 2016, 2018 (jointly with Pakistan), 2023 and 2024. A victory on Thursday would take their tally to six titles. 18:15 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: Dominant semi-final victory Their attacking strength was on full display in the semi-final against South Korea. Shilanand Lakra and Dilpreet Singh scored twice each, while Harmanpreet Singh, Sukhjeet Singh, Angad Bir Singh and Vivek Sagar Prasad also got on the scoresheet in the comprehensive 8-1 victory. 18:05 (IST) Nov 05 India vs Japan Hockey Final Live Score: India eye title India have been the standout team in the competition, finishing the league stage with a perfect record of five wins from five matches. The hosts accumulated 15 points, scoring 34 goals and conceding just five, underlining their superiority across the group stage.
